decision: The bag is usable as an organizer-synthetic diagnostic panel, but the unchanged detector does not pass all ten scenarios. No field recall is established.

attribution.method: Forensic contiguous intensity=1 suffix after zero-return boundary, tracked by raw geometry and temporal continuity, then original-point indices through detector. All ten trajectories accounted for. No supplied per-point labels.
attribution.component_rule: At least 50% inserted support for standalone attribution; mixed components retained separately.
attribution.coverage: Every frame containing inferred insertions through frame 803, not just every tenth frame.

contour_disagreement.observation: Organizer-described outside objects produce confirmed intersection. At frame 520 event 5 has measured lateral support approximately -1.31 to -0.98 m, height 1.09 to 1.37 m above estimated railhead; this is inside the current reference contour. At frame 620 parts of event 7 also fall inside that contour.
contour_disagreement.current_contour: GOST 23961-80 M reference, not independently calibrated to organizer synthetic envelope or actual swept vehicle envelope.
contour_disagreement.decision: Report disagreement rather than silently shrink contour or declare proven false alarms. Need generator contour/frame/object placement, not more field data.

negative_tail.validity: No inferred appended points; not independently exhaustively reviewed real negatives.

performance.scope: Apple M3 offline diagnostic run, every-tenth-frame full arrays and concurrent input inspection. Not target Intel or live ROS end-to-end latency.

next_actions: Resolve organizer contour and supplied object poses/labels; preserve the current baseline.
Investigate odometry-gated temporal confirmation for low/very thin obstacles: detected component is not the same as confirmed hazard.
Investigate merged infrastructure and intermittent decisions separately from source visibility.
limitations: Synthetic organizer data, not field accuracy or hardware detection range.
First object already visible at bag start; its maximum acquisition distance cannot be measured here.
Archive has no generator or timestamped labels. Approximate object descriptions do not settle all boundary cases.
No detector thresholds, source code or native binary changed for this evaluation.
